pretreatment: 10 cycles of Al2O3 or TiO2 were used to coat the silica gel
evidence: Spherical silica gel (Silicycle S10040M) with a surface area of about 100 m2 g^-1, a primary particle size of 75–200 mm, and a nominal pore diameter of 30 nm was used as an initial substrate. Prior to the ABC-type Pd ALD, 10 cycles of Al2O3 or TiO2 were used to coat the silica gel at 177 8C by alternatively exposing TMA and H2O (50, 150, 200, 200), or at 150 8C by alternatively exposing TTIP and H2O (60, 240, 120, 240).
